This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Xexto was among the five podracers who [[Muunilinst Podrace|raced]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Muunilinst. During the race, the lower left engine of the Xexto's podracer, a quad-engined [[Balta-Trabaat/Legends|Balta-Trabaat]] [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310]], careened into the side of the cliff. The engine exploded along with the podracer, and it is not known whether the Xexto survived.<ref name="Target" />
